recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-9239; future work on later Timing abbreviation additions or generated terminology packaging should remain with their own issue family rather than reopening this DSTU2 migration.
issue_request: FHIR-9239 was a Published/Persuasive MnM DSTU2 change request asking that the Timing Abbreviation and Identifier Type value-set codes be migrated out of FHIR-owned code systems to the relevant v3 and v2 code systems.
initial_application: Timing was addressed by the post-harmonization source history: dbd836d2e3ef43f83a940d8ea0b101bc4bf3b8cb moved seed-era Timing abbreviation rows such as QD/QOD/Q4H/Q6H to v3 GTSAbbreviation, and d1f387ce5e71114e7369ac9dd345022ded36edd0 later updated v2/v3 URLs to terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem URLs. Identifier Type was explicitly applied by 935f74cd0eea1f34d310215a5d78ce192122e241, GF#9239, which removed the FHIR-specific identifier-type include and used v2 table 0203 codes instead.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Identifier and Timing in the [types] section, so the checked datatype spreadsheets and terminology inputs are in current build scope. The current Identifier Type value set composes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0203. The current Timing abbreviation worksheet uses http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-GTSAbbreviation for the migrated seed-era rows. The remaining C/Continuous timing abbreviation is a later Published issue, FHIR-20609, already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-13520 similarly added later timing abbreviations and is already represented. Zulip #terminology > Table 0203 supports the v2 table 0203 availability trail, and no Confluence reference or conflicting later decision was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already uses non-FHIR v2/v3 code systems for the seed-era Identifier Type and Timing Abbreviation codes, and focused searches found no active FHIR-owned identifier-type or timing-abbreviation source needing correction for this issue.

related_jiras.note: Added C/Continuous to the Timing Abbreviations ValueSet after FHIR-9239; explains the current non-v3/generated Timing C row and is already represented on the combined branch.
